phase: Phase 4: Air-Gapped IaC Security & Trivy Config Engine

findings_detail.message:
Artifact: configmap.yaml
Type: kubernetes
Vulnerability KSV-01010
Severity: MEDIUM
Message: ConfigMap 'user-service-config' in 'default' namespace stores sensitive contents in key(s) or value(s) '{"      from", "      username", "  email"}'
Link: [KSV-01010](https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/ksv-01010)

Artifact: deployment.yaml
Type: kubernetes
Vulnerability KSV-0110
Severity: LOW
Message: deployment user-service in default namespace should set metadata.namespace to a non-default namespace
Link: [KSV-0110](https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/ksv-0110)

Artifact: deployment.yaml
Type: kubernetes
Vulnerability KSV-0125
Severity: MEDIUM
Message: Container user-service in deployment user-service (namespace: default) uses an image from an untrusted registry.
Link: [KSV-0125](https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/ksv-0125)
